_comment: Golden vectors for the content-addressed recipe tag.
The tag is a function of the recipe alone, so four implementations must
agree byte for byte: ee/dagron-build (Rust, the builder that actually
produces the image), the Python SDK, the TypeScript SDK, and the console
(frontend/src/ee/recipe.ts, which cannot use either SDK because a browser
has no node:crypto). When they disagree, an author pins a task to an image
no build will ever push, and nothing fails until the run does.
These vectors are generated FROM the Rust builder (it is the source of
against by all three. Regenerate only when the format version changes,
and expect every tag to change when it does — that is the point of
where canonical_json is the recipe serialized with fields in DECLARATION
order (not alphabetical), absent/empty/false fields omitted, env sorted by
key, no whitespace, and non-ASCII emitted raw rather than escaped.

vectors.why: Only the two required fields. Everything else is omitted by skip_serializing_if, so this pins the empty-field encoding.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'minimal' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: Every field set, so a field dropped from the canonical form or moved out of declaration order changes the hash.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'every-field' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM docker.io/library/python:3.12-slim
ENV PIP_INDEX_URL="https://mirror.internal/simple"
ENV TZ="UTC"
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'curl' 'ca-certificates' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir 'duckdb==1.1.3' 'pandas==2.2.2'
WORKDIR /app
COPY files/app/run.py /app/run.py
COPY files/app/entry.sh /app/entry.sh
RUN pip install -r /app/requirements.txt
USER app

vectors.why: env is a BTreeMap in Rust: keys are sorted, not insertion ordered. Written here deliberately out of order.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'env-key-order' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
ENV A0="5"
ENV Mike="3"
ENV ZULU="1"
ENV _under="4"
ENV alpha="2"
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: JSON string escaping: quotes and backslashes.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'quotes-and-backslashes' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: Escapes that have a short form in JSON.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'newlines-and-tabs' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: C0 controls have no short form and become \u00xx. DEL (0x7f) is NOT escaped by serde_json, which is the trap.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'control-chars' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: Non-ASCII must be emitted raw UTF-8, not \uXXXX — Python's json.dumps escapes it unless ensure_ascii is False.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'unicode-bmp' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: Astral-plane code points: one Rust char, a surrogate pair in UTF-16 languages. Includes a ZWJ sequence.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'unicode-astral' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: JSON permits escaping / but serde_json does not. An encoder that escapes it (some JS ones do) changes the hash.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'solidus' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: An empty string is not the same as an absent field: content:"" must appear in the canonical form.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'empty-content' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY files/a /a
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: executable: false is skipped, so it must not appear.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'executable-false' -- change the recipe, not this file.

COPY files/a /a

vectors.why: dockerfile: bypasses synthesis but still hashes.
A bool that is skipped when false and present when true.
vectors.dockerfile:

FROM alpine:3.20

vectors.why: Every field the console's recipe form offers, and nothing else: it deliberately has no `run` or `dockerfile`, so `every-field` cannot cover it.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'console-fields' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM docker.io/library/python:3.12-slim
ENV LANG="C.UTF-8"
ENV TZ="UTC"
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'curl' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir 'duckdb==1.1.3'
WORKDIR /app
COPY files/app/q.py /app/q.py
COPY files/app/go.sh /app/go.sh
USER app

vectors.why: An explicit JSON null is the SAME recipe as an absent field: serde reads null as None and omits it. A port that gates on `!== undefined` rather than `!= null` emits the null and hashes different bytes than the builder — which is exactly what the TypeScript SDK did, and why a recipe parsed from a file (a bare `dockerfile:` in YAML is null) pinned a tag no build would ever push.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'explicit-nulls' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir 'duckdb==1.1.3'
ENTRYPOINT []

vectors.why: Lists are ordered: reordering apt or pip is a different image.
vectors.dockerfile:
# Generated by dagron-build/v2 from recipe 'list-order' -- change the recipe, not this file.
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'b' 'a' 'c' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir 'z==1' 'y==2'
ENTRYPOINT []
